notes: File > Export PDF for Bluebeam: a copy of each drawing with your takeoff on it as Bluebeam markups (counts, pipe runs with their lengths, notes, highlights, dimensions), each folder a layer, in a new exports folder in the job. The bottom bar shows the drawing's paper size and scale. File > New Sheet… puts drawings side by side on a new page (also on a page's right-click menu).
